While the Reflector instructions warn against over-interpreting low confidence in AI images, the specific failure of the pose model to locate the shoulders and hips (which are partially visible or implied) suggests subtle structural ambiguity or 'melting' in the neck-to-body transition that the Router missed. The Topology mask shows a clean boundary, but the internal structure confidence is low. I will slightly increase the artifact severity to account for this structural uncertainty.
